questions.question_english: Can a cancer patient take chemotherapy pills during Ramadan fasting according to Hanafi fiqh?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya cancer patient Hanafi fiqh ke mutabiq Ramadan ke roze mein chemotherapy ki goliyan le sakta hai?

questions.question_english: Does receiving a chemotherapy injection through a vein break the fast in the Hanafi school?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Hanafi school mein nas (vein) ke zariye chemotherapy injection lene se roza toot jata hai?

questions.question_english: Can a diabetic Muslim break their Ramadan fast to take insulin?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya diabetic Muslim insulin lene ke liye apna Ramadan ka roza tod sakta hai?

questions.question_english: If a patient takes painkillers during Ramadan because of severe pain, is their fast broken?
questions.question_hinglish: Agar koi patient Ramadan mein severe pain ki wajah se painkillers le, to kya uska roza toot jata hai?

questions.question_english: Can a Muslim patient use a morphine patch for cancer pain during Ramadan without breaking the fast?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Muslim patient Ramadan mein cancer pain ke liye morphine patch use kar sakta hai bina roza tode?

questions.question_english: Is it permissible in Islam for a terminally ill patient to stop fasting permanently?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Islam mein terminally ill patient ke liye hamesha ke liye roza chhod dena jaiz hai?

questions.question_english: Does receiving a blood transfusion during Ramadan break the fast according to Hanafi scholars?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Hanafi ulama ke mutabiq Ramadan mein blood transfusion lene se roza toot jata hai?

questions.question_english: Can a Muslim patient use an asthma inhaler while fasting in Ramadan?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Muslim patient Ramadan mein roze ki halat mein asthma inhaler use kar sakta hai?

questions.question_english: Is it permissible for a cancer patient to eat during Ramadan if fasting causes serious harm?
questions.question_hinglish: Agar roza rakhne se serious nuksaan ho to kya cancer patient ke liye Ramadan mein khana jaiz hai?

questions.question_english: Does an IV drip administered during Ramadan invalidate the fast in Hanafi fiqh?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Hanafi fiqh mein Ramadan ke dauran IV drip lagwane se roza baatil ho jata hai?

questions.question_english: Is it permissible in Islam for a Muslim to undergo surgery that carries a risk of death?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Islam mein Muslim ke liye aisi surgery karwana jaiz hai jismein maut ka risk ho?

questions.question_english: Can a Muslim patient consent to surgery without informing their family according to Islamic ethics?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Islamic ethics ke mutabiq Muslim patient apni family ko bataye bina surgery ke liye consent de sakta hai?

questions.question_english: Is general anaesthesia during surgery permissible in Islam?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Islam mein surgery ke dauran general anaesthesia jaiz hai?

questions.question_english: Does being under anaesthesia during prayer time require a Muslim to make up missed prayers?
questions.question_hinglish: Agar namaz ke waqt koi anaesthesia mein behosh ho, to kya Muslim ko chhooti hui namazein qaza karni hongi?

questions.question_english: Is it permissible in Islam to delay a necessary surgery because of Ramadan?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Islam mein Ramadan ki wajah se zaroori surgery ko delay karna jaiz hai?

questions.question_english: Can a Muslim woman undergo surgery performed by a male doctor if no female doctor is available?
questions.question_hinglish: Agar female doctor available na ho to kya Muslim aurat male doctor se surgery karwa sakti hai?

questions.question_english: Is cosmetic surgery permissible in Islam for reconstructive purposes after cancer treatment?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Islam mein cancer treatment ke baad reconstructive purpose ke liye cosmetic surgery jaiz hai?

questions.question_english: Is it permissible in Islam to remove a cancerous organ to save a patient's life?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Islam mein patient ki jaan bachane ke liye cancerous organ nikalna jaiz hai?

questions.question_english: Can a Muslim patient refuse surgery on religious grounds even if doctors say it is necessary?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Muslim patient religious wajah se surgery se inkaar kar sakta hai, chahe doctors kahein ke zaroori hai?

questions.question_english: Is it permissible in Islam to perform surgery on a Friday?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Islam mein Jumma (Friday) ke din surgery karna jaiz hai?

questions.question_english: Is blood transfusion permissible in Islam when a patient's life is at risk?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Islam mein blood transfusion jaiz hai jab patient ki jaan khatre mein ho?

questions.question_english: Is organ donation after death permissible in Hanafi fiqh?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Hanafi fiqh mein maut ke baad organ donation jaiz hai?

questions.question_english: Can a living Muslim donate one kidney to save another person's life?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya zinda Muslim kisi doosre ki jaan bachane ke liye apni ek kidney donate kar sakta hai?

questions.question_english: Is it permissible in Islam to receive an organ from a non-Muslim donor?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Islam mein non-Muslim donor se organ lena jaiz hai?

questions.question_english: Is bone marrow donation permissible in Islam?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Islam mein bone marrow donation jaiz hai?

questions.question_english: Can a Muslim family consent to organ donation on behalf of a deceased family member who left no instructions?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Muslim family kisi marhoom family member ki taraf se organ donation ka consent de sakti hai jisne koi hidayat nahi chhodi?

questions.question_english: Is it permissible in Islam to receive a pig-derived heart valve if no alternative exists?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Islam mein pig se bana heart valve lena jaiz hai agar koi aur option na ho?

questions.question_english: Is blood donation permissible during Ramadan fasting in Hanafi fiqh?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Hanafi fiqh mein Ramadan ke roze ki halat mein blood donate karna jaiz hai?

questions.question_english: Can a Muslim accept a blood donation from someone of another religion?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Muslim kisi doosre mazhab ke shakhs se blood donation le sakta hai?

questions.question_english: Is it permissible in Islam to sell blood or organs for money?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Islam mein paison ke liye khoon ya organs bechna jaiz hai?

questions.question_english: Is it permissible in Islam to use strong painkillers that may shorten a terminal patient's life?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Islam mein aise strong painkillers dena jaiz hai jo terminal patient ki zindagi kam kar sakte hain?

questions.question_english: Can a Muslim family request doctors to stop life support for a terminally ill patient?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Muslim family doctors se terminally ill patient ka life support band karne ko keh sakti hai?

questions.question_english: Is euthanasia or assisted dying permissible in Islam under any circumstances?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Islam mein kisi bhi halat mein euthanasia ya assisted dying jaiz hai?

questions.question_english: What is the Islamic ruling on keeping a brain-dead patient on life support?
questions.question_hinglish: Brain-dead patient ko life support par rakhne ke baare mein Islamic hukm kya hai?

questions.question_english: Can a Muslim patient write a do-not-resuscitate order according to Islamic ethics?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Islamic ethics ke mutabiq Muslim patient do-not-resuscitate (DNR) order likh sakta hai?

questions.question_english: Is it permissible in Islam for a terminally ill patient to refuse further treatment?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Islam mein terminally ill patient ke liye mazeed treatment se inkaar karna jaiz hai?

questions.question_english: How should a Muslim patient handle missed prayers when hospitalized and unable to move?
questions.question_hinglish: Hospital mein bhartee Muslim patient jo hil nahi sakta, apni chhooti hui namazon ko kaise handle kare?

questions.question_english: Is it permissible in Islam to give a dying patient sedation that reduces their consciousness in final hours?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Islam mein marne wale patient ko aakhri ghanton mein aisi sedation dena jaiz hai jo uska hosh kam kar de?

questions.question_english: What is the Islamic ruling on autopsy after a Muslim's death?
questions.question_hinglish: Muslim ki maut ke baad autopsy (postmortem) ke baare mein Islamic hukm kya hai?

questions.question_english: Is it permissible in Islam to delay burial for medical investigation purposes?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Islam mein medical investigation ke liye dafan (burial) mein deri karna jaiz hai?

questions.question_english: Is gender reassignment surgery permissible in Islam under any circumstances?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Islam mein kisi bhi halat mein gender reassignment surgery jaiz hai?

questions.question_english: Is abortion permissible in Islam if the pregnancy results from rape (sexual assault)?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Islam mein abortion jaiz hai agar pregnancy rape (zabardasti / sexual assault) ka nateeja ho?

questions.question_english: Is abortion permissible in Islam if the foetus has a severe fatal medical condition?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Islam mein abortion jaiz hai agar foetus ko koi severe fatal medical condition ho?

questions.question_english: What is the Islamic ruling on abortion before 40 days of pregnancy in Hanafi fiqh?
questions.question_hinglish: Hanafi fiqh mein pregnancy ke 40 din se pehle abortion ka Islamic hukm kya hai?

questions.question_english: Is IVF permissible in Islam for a married Muslim couple?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Islam mein shaadi-shuda Muslim couple ke liye IVF jaiz hai?

questions.question_english: Is surrogacy permissible in Islam?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Islam mein surrogacy jaiz hai?

questions.question_english: Is prenatal genetic testing permissible in Islam?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Islam mein prenatal genetic testing jaiz hai?

questions.question_english: Is it permissible in Islam to use contraception to protect the mother's health?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Islam mein maa ki sehat ki hifazat ke liye contraception use karna jaiz hai?

questions.question_english: Is vasectomy or permanent sterilization permissible in Islam?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Islam mein vasectomy ya permanent sterilization jaiz hai?

questions.question_english: Is mental health treatment including psychiatric medication permissible in Islam?
questions.question_hinglish: Kya Islam mein mental health treatment, jismein psychiatric medication bhi shamil hai, jaiz hai?
